missing-manifest: The package has no skin.json at its root.
unsupported-format: This skin uses format {value}, which this version of Ninjoy does not support. Please update Ninjoy.
package-too-large: The skin is too large ({bytes} bytes; the limit is {max} bytes).
missing-file: File "{file}" is referenced but not present in the package.
invalid-svg: "{file}" is not a valid SVG file: {reason}
unknown-field: Unknown field "{field}" in skin.json; it is ignored.
unknown-control: Group "{group}" lists "{control}", which is not a control of this skin.
control-in-two-groups: Control "{control}" belongs to more than one group (also in "{group}").
anchor-ignored: Control "{control}" declares an anchor but belongs to group "{group}"; the group's anchor is used.
outside-canvas: Control "{control}" is partly or completely outside the 1600 x 720 canvas.
no-menu: This skin has no menu button; players will not be able to open the Ninjoy menu from the controller.
no-preview: This skin has no preview image.
unused-file: File "{file}" is not used by the skin.
unknown-element: Control "{control}" refers to element "{element}", which does not exist in "{file}".
conflicting-roles: Element "{element}" of control "{control}" gets different roles directly and through its group.
too-many-hitboxes: Control "{control}" has more than one hitbox; use a single shape.
hitbox-not-single-shape: The hitbox "{element}" of control "{control}" is a group; the hitbox must be a single shape.
missing-touch-area: Control "{control}" has neither a hitbox nor a base, so it has no touch area.
role-not-allowed: Role "{role}" of element "{element}" is not allowed on control "{control}".
role-ignored: Role "{role}" of element "{element}" has no effect on control "{control}" and is ignored.
unsafe-element: "{file}" contains a <{element}> element, which is not allowed in skins.
unsafe-attribute: "{file}" has a "{attribute}" attribute on <{element}>; event handlers are not allowed in skins.
unsafe-reference: "{file}" refers to "{value}" from <{element}>; skins may only use files inside the package.
unsafe-css: "{file}" contains CSS that loads external content: {value}
unsafe-doctype: "{file}" declares entities in its DOCTYPE, which is not allowed in skins.
fixed-mixed-group: Group "{group}" mixes fixed controls with controls that resize; make them all fixed or none.
